maximum_depth_rule: All 435 canonical Phase 9 Reviewed statements are retained exactly once with their registered PDF, source location, raw text, tokens, unit, scope, operator, and unresolved comparability boundary.
version_boundary: The ten-year vision, fiscal 2023 to 2026 policy direction, outcome indicators, annual implementation status, settlement results, spending, explanatory text, and individual-plan indicators remain separate layers.
non_goals: Do not infer additional records from unregistered plan text or individual source documents.
Do not collapse year columns, baselines, actuals, targets, explanations, and settlement amounts into one series.
Do not convert spending or implementation descriptions directly into verified policy outcomes.
Do not calculate policy achievement, causality, or cross-prefecture ranking.
